title: spec_closed event payload
$comment: Class: REQUIRES_SPEC_ID. Records the lifecycle transition active -> closed.

supersedes.description: When resolution=superseded, the spec id this one supersedes (mirror of spec.supersedes).

merge_commit.description: Optional merge commit SHA when closure followed a worktree merge.

successors.description: The structured successor declarations carried by the spec at close time, preserved verbatim. This is the audit record of what the author DECIDED; target standing is deliberately not projected, since it is derivable from each target's own history and would go stale here.

prior_worktree.description: Worktree name this spec was bound to immediately before close. Recorded when closeSpec clears a top-level `worktree:` field as part of the close transaction. Audit-trail record per WORKTREE-MERGE-CLEARS-SPEC-BINDING-001.
